title: ジャパンカップにむけて

text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japan Cup.
Ruuumble…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Is this an earthquake?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: N-no… It's the air…

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Someone's falling out of the sky!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, haaah ha ha ha! I'm double—no, 500 times the greatness!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O descends! Behold, world! The Overlord has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoooooa!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Excellent work operating the crane, Trainer. Now, off to the paddock.
Ruuumble…
T.M. Opera O's impact has most definitely increased.
There's a frightening aura at the course when we arrive at the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O… That was so cool. I could—well, I could never do that…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But I have to hold strong and, um… try to have the best race I can.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Although… what happens after that?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Will I be your enemy forever? Or…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, my old friend. How do you feel? Is your heart set?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Are you ready to don the title Dark Tempest Lord and become the Centurial Overlord's lifelong nemesis?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Dark Tempest… Lord?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I… I don't know. But…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I think I'll know after running with you today, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Because I think I'll get to see the real you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. And you shall, as I reach the apex of true beauty.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Very well! I will speak with you again once the race has finished.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us begin. My predecessors await me on the next battlefield, the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This is the eve of the match! Let us treat our worldwide guests to a grand and lively event.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!
